name: General access problems
definition: Complaints that the user cannot get into the app or account with no clearer cause; not phone-number, password or launch errors.
title: Playback errors and crashes after updates
description: Users report playback failure errors, random crashes, and content not loading, saying the app worked well before recent updates.

name: Phone number login errors
definition: Login rejected with check-your-number or cannot-connect messages when using a phone number; not password or social login.
title: Login fails and app logs out
description: Users report the app repeatedly logs them out and rejects login details, making account changes difficult and blocking phone-based access.

name: Password and social login failures
definition: Password, email or Facebook login that is rejected or errors; not phone-number login.
title: Google and phone login failures
description: Users report that single sign-on through Google fails, phone-number login stops working, and songs gray out with a false no-connection message.

name: Logouts and signup blocks
definition: Being logged out unexpectedly, losing an account, or being unable to create or finish signing up; not repeated login errors.
title: Session and playlist access failures
description: Users report being logged out and losing downloads, being unable to add songs to playlists, and restrictions on choosing or liking particular songs.

name: App fails to open or connect
definition: App stuck on the splash screen or showing connection or no-internet errors at launch; not playback errors after login.
title: App fails to open or log in
description: Users say the app won't open, shows nothing loading, or claims there is no internet even when connected, even after reinstalling.

name: General usability problems
definition: Complaints about how the app works or feels that fit no other usability subtopic.
title: Updates make app hard to navigate
description: Reviewers say recent updates made it harder to select songs, sort lists, and move around, and that each update seems to worsen navigation.

name: Ad frequency and placement
definition: Too many ads, ads that play after an ad-free window, or ads interrupting listening; not paywall pricing.
title: Excessive irrelevant ads for free users
description: Free users say ads are frequent, annoying and irrelevant, and feel forced to listen to them because they cannot afford premium.

name: Shuffle, order and seeking
definition: Forced shuffle, inability to play songs in order, repeat or seek to a part of a track, when not caused by free-tier limits; controls locked to premium go to billing.
title: Shuffle, skip and rewind removed
description: Customers report that shuffle, loop, unlimited skips, rewinding and playing specific parts of songs were removed or restricted after an update.

name: Interface and layout changes
definition: Redesigned screens, removed icons, or features moved or hidden after an update; not missing features locked by premium.
title: Redesigned layout removes familiar features
description: Users say redesigns removed quick links, playlist visibility, recently played access, and queue or sorting options they relied on.

name: General playback problems
definition: Complaints that audio does not play properly with no clearer pattern, including bad quality.
title: Audio glitches, hangs and quality drops
description: Users describe songs skipping or dropping in quality, the app hanging, and offline or downloaded playback behaving unreliably.

name: Playback stops or app crashes
definition: Music stops mid-track or after one song, or the app crashes while playing; not slow loading.
title: Songs stop playing and app crashes
description: Customers report that songs stop unexpectedly and cannot be replayed, playlists fail to load, and the app goes dead or crashes after updates.

name: Buffering and slow loading
definition: Long waits to load lists or start tracks, and buffering or glitching during playback.
title: Laggy app and slow loading
description: Users describe the app as very laggy and slow, with music pausing for seconds and network-related loading problems not seen in other apps.

name: False offline or no-internet errors
definition: App reports no connection or offline status even though the internet works; not launch failures.
title: False no-internet errors despite connection
description: Users say the app shows a no internet connection error while they are connected, and that now-playing controls or rewinding disappear.

name: Bluetooth, car and watch control
definition: Problems controlling or connecting playback through Bluetooth, car systems or smartwatches.
title: Bluetooth connection and queue control issues
description: Users report Bluetooth headsets and car connections drop or behave oddly, and they cannot control track selection or queues from connected devices.

name: General download problems
definition: Download complaints that fit no other downloads subtopic.
title: Downloaded and liked songs fail to load
description: Users report downloaded songs loading slowly, liked songs disappearing, and playlists stuck syncing before going offline.

name: Downloads fail to start or save
definition: Songs or podcasts cannot be downloaded at all or stall during download; not deleted after saving.
title: Downloads fail to save or sync
description: Users report that songs only download when clicked, that SD card transfers fail, and that reinstalling does not fix repeated download failures.

name: Downloads disappear or re-download
definition: Saved downloads are deleted, lost after updates, or downloaded again repeatedly.
title: Downloads removed unexpectedly after logout
description: Users say downloaded songs and playlists are deleted automatically, often after logout or over time, forcing them to re-download music.

name: Offline playback needs network
definition: Downloaded content will not play offline or still needs a connection to start; not failure to download.
title: Offline playback fails without network
description: Users say downloaded playlists and songs won't play offline, and the app hangs searching for them, which is frustrating on long drives or without signal.

name: General catalog gaps
definition: Complaints about the music library or content that fit no other catalog subtopic.
title: Songs greyed out, albums fail to load
description: Users report songs greyed out and unplayable, liked songs and artist albums not loading, and general dissatisfaction with recent updates.

name: Recommended and suggested content
definition: Recommended songs, suggested clips or autoplay replacing what the user chose to play; not songs added to the user's own playlists.
title: Shuffle and recommendations feel stale
description: Users say recommendations and autoplay repeat the same songs, do not match their taste, and that smart shuffle adds tracks they cannot track.

name: Lyrics missing or not loading
definition: Lyrics not shown, failing to load, or lyric features missing; not lyrics locked behind premium.
title: Lyrics missing or fail to load
description: Users say lyrics are never shown, show a couldn't load message, or are incorrect or absent for most songs, despite updates.

name: Songs or podcasts missing or removed
definition: Specific songs, artists, shows or episodes are absent, unavailable or removed from the catalog.
title: Songs unavailable or removed from catalog
description: Users report that favorite songs, albums, and regional music such as Bollywood tracks disappear or show as unavailable, even after reinstalling.

name: Unwanted songs added to playlists
definition: The app adds songs to the user's own playlists without consent; not recommendations shown separately.
title: Random songs added to playlists
description: Users find unwanted tracks appearing in their own playlists, including other people's songs, and playback jumping to songs they do not want to hear.

name: Content bias and policy complaints
definition: Complaints about artist favoritism, controversial hosts, or removal of content for political or policy reasons.
title: Music removals over political content
description: Users object to Spotify removing music or artists, and accuse it of political censorship, which leads some to say they will leave the service.

name: General billing complaints
definition: Complaints about premium or payment that fit no other billing subtopic.
title: Paid tier lacks value
description: Users feel the paid plan is not worth it, citing paywalled basics, missing songs, and ads even for paying members.

name: Basic features locked behind premium
definition: Features users expected for free, such as lyrics, skipping, choosing songs, queue, seeking or downloading, are locked to premium; not the subscription price itself.
title: Basic features moved behind premium paywall
description: Users say core features such as lyrics, loop, previous track, and queue are now locked behind a premium subscription, which they see as unfair.

name: Premium price too high
definition: Complaints that the premium subscription costs too much for the value; not feature locks.
title: Premium price too high
description: Users find the premium subscription too expensive for their budget, especially in regions without a free ad-supported tier, and feel ads remain intrusive.

name: Charges, purchases and cancellation
definition: Unexpected charges, cancellation not working, or purchase and region errors when buying premium.
title: Charged without warning, features unusable
description: Subscribers say they are charged without reminders, and that paid accounts cannot use downloaded music offline or get the benefits they paid for.

name: General support complaints
definition: Complaints about customer support that fit no other support subtopic.
title: Vague frustration with company and pricing
description: Users express general discontent with the company, its pricing, and its artist payouts, and say they will stop using or subscribing to the service.

name: Unhelpful or rude support replies
definition: Support agents or replies that are unhelpful, scripted, rude or absent.
title: Support gives unhelpful, slow responses
description: Users say support emails go unanswered, and that suggested fixes like reinstalling fail to solve persistent bugs reported long ago.

name: Support channels not working
definition: Email, forms or support pages that glitch or cannot be found; not the quality of replies.
title: Support contact channels unavailable or broken
description: Users report customer service has no phone line, limits help to text or chat, and that in-app support website links are broken.

name: Other
definition: General criticism with no supported specific topic
title: Vague general dissatisfaction without specifics
description: Reviewers express broad frustration with the app, often tied to free-tier limits, feature access, or wanting parity with other platforms.
